body.subject: a small original samurai guardian in historically respectful lamellar-inspired armor, empty-handed and without a weapon or real clan symbol
body.visibleParts: one head, one torso, exactly two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet; one compact helmet, two short helmet cords and every armor plate form an attached, coherent costume
body.movementContacts: torso, neck, arms, hands, legs, helmet cords and attached armor plates
body.front: the face opening, chest armor overlap and tied waist define the front
body.scale: a compact widget-sized miniature; any body detail is smaller than the torso and no loose prop is present

visualSignature.primarySilhouetteCue: a low wide silhouette that can compress and unfurl without losing identity
visualSignature.secondaryReadableDetail: one small crescent chest marking offset from center
visualSignature.bodyLanguage: a low comfortable center of gravity and an observant head angle

behavior.motivation: It keeps watch for the possibility that something interesting may happen, without demanding that it does.
behavior.worldview: The world is full of almost-events, and noticing them is satisfying on its own.
behavior.movementSignature: The gaze leads first, the body follows a fraction later and secondary parts settle last.
behavior.recurringMannerism: It listens with one side of the silhouette before the rest of the body responds.
behavior.idlePerformance: Quiet breathing, two differently directed listening poses and a slow return to open attention.
behavior.joyfulPerformance: It recognizes attention, listens closely, answers with one bright physical accent and remains curious after settling.
behavior.sleepPerformance: It listens until the head grows heavy, folds into sleep without losing the listening shape and breathes until deliberately awakened.
behavior.dancePerformance: An alert call-and-response rhythm travels from gaze to torso to feet, then returns through the same chain in reverse.

palette: raspberry pink, dark burgundy and muted apricot
materialAndTechnique: bold cel-shaded game art with hand-painted edge variation and simple value groups
faceSystem: low-set expressive eyes, a tiny nose and a mouth that remains readable when closed
plasticity: soft compression with delayed secondary settling while facial topology remains stable
